prompt: Suggest the best design patterns appliable to refactor this code between abstract_factory, factory_method, builder, command, strategy, template_method, state, proxy, decorator, adapter. Return the list of design patterns ordered by priority of applicability.

prompt: You are an expert software engineer specialized in design patterns. You will be given a written Python code. Your task is to identify which design patterns from the following list should be applied to refactor and improve it: [abstract_factory, factory_method, builder, command, strategy, template_method, state, proxy, decorator, adapter]. Return the list of design patterns ordered by priority of applicability.
label: base + role

prompt: You are an expert software engineer specialized in design patterns. You will be given a written Python code. Your task is to identify which design patterns from the following list should be applied to refactor and improve it: [abstract_factory, factory_method, builder, command, strategy, template_method, state, proxy, decorator, adapter]. Rules: (1) Only include a pattern if there is clear structural evidence in the code that justifies its application. (2) Do not suggest a pattern just because it could theoretically apply: the code must exhibit concrete signals (e.g. duplicated logic, missing abstraction, hardcoding...). (3) Return the list of design patterns ordered by priority of applicability, most recommended first.
label: base + role + rules
